title: Motion
description: Create animated visuals from a prompt or React source, then export them to your Library.
label: Project name
unverifiedVision: Vision support for this model is unverified. Inspection may fail; any consumed work still costs credits.
libraryHint: Select up to 12 of your latest 50 Library assets. Reference them with staticFile("assets/ASSET_ID").
limits: Up to 30 seconds, 1920×1080 pixels, 24 or 30 fps, and 8 outputs. Prompt revisions inherit the previous settings and output selection.
sourceHint: Export a named VisualComposition component. React and Remotion are available. Direct source is retained exactly and never automatically repaired.
billingHint: The ceiling reserves the maximum. Actual authoring, inspection and rendering work is charged even if you cancel or an output fails. Unused credits are released. Retry is a new invocation; check prior uncertainty diagnostics first.
acknowledge: I approve up to {maximum} credits for this request.
invalidFrames: Enter integer frame numbers separated by commas.
invalidProps: Props must be a JSON object.
staleRevision: This project changed elsewhere. Reload the latest revision, then try again.
unavailable: The isolated renderer is unavailable. Contact your operator.
inheritedOutputs: Prompt, source and props revisions keep these outputs:

onboarding.title: Describe it, preview it, export it
onboarding.description: Motion turns a prompt into an animated video or still frames you can drop into your Library. Pick a preset to fill in the form, then edit it your way.
onboarding.presetsDescription: A preset only fills in the form. You review a credit quote and confirm it before anything is rendered.
